# ZisK verifier test dependency

These Solidity files are unchanged copies of [`zisk-contracts` at `v1.3.2-alpha`](https://github.com/0xPolygonHermez/zisk/tree/1e22630bb7e143c30705a1603ed87cfd3da8c6ec/zisk-contracts). They are compiled only by the Foundry tests. Their upstream SPDX license headers and attribution are preserved.

The scoped Git attribute ignores trailing whitespace in these unchanged upstream sources.

The Vector deployment must use a verifier compatible with its proving keys; this test pins the verifier used to validate the committed PLONK fixtures.
